short: Coefficients of the inverse Lubin–Tate logarithm

lean.name: Formalism.DworkPowerSeriesWeights.LemmaSt
lean.plain: Coefficients of the inverse Lubin–Tate logarithm
lean.note: Inverting the logarithm can cost at most $(r-1)/(\ell^2-1)$ in valuation in degree $r$. Passing from a Taylor coefficient to a derivative supplies the valuation of $r!$, giving the rate $\ell/(\ell^2-1)$ per order up to logarithmic loss.
